title: Pregnant Duo #15
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each an extraordinarily large pregnant woman, far beyond any real person.

#1: Nigerian, in her early 50s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust, and an extremely sharply cinched waist still visible at her sides even as a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward prominently from the centre of that narrow waistline — the dramatic waist-to-hip contrast still reading clearly around the belly's own round curve. Enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than the narrow waist. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter glowing on the cheekbones, bold shimmering gold and emerald eyeshadow blended out toward the temples, dramatic long lashes, sharply defined brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong glossy fuchsia-pink lip, long braids piled into a high sculpted crown, a bright, joyful smile, elegant updo hair, real pores, real living eyes, 8 a mix of hoops, studs and drops piercings set with sapphires in bronze-toned metal, wearing a single piece of silver an anklet. Painted in Spanish Talavera de la Reina ceramic, a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre floral medallions, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide cobalt bands curving fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the densest concentration of floral medallion border wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's centrepiece and continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both arms raised overhead framing her silhouette, belly and bust both fully displayed, confident direct gaze, extreme cobalt extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Latina, in her mid 40s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. Both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous — a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below — and between them, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward, her waistline already soft and gently defined even without the pregnancy, now continuing that same soft fullness into the belly's round curve with no harsh transition anywhere. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, warm golden-bronze skin, a sharp black winged liner, warm terracotta eyeshadow, heavy lashes, strong sculpted contour, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep berry lip, long voluminous dark-brown waves swept over one shoulder, a fiery, passionate expression, curly hair, real pores, real living eyes, 100 drop dangles piercings set with diamonds in bronze-toned metal, wearing four to six pieces, layered of silver a necklace. Painted in Islamic geometric star-tile pattern, a dense precise pattern of interlocking eight-pointed stars, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide gold bands curving fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the densest concentration of geometric star-and-polygon tile wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's centrepiece and continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised, one hand on the raised knee and the other cradling her belly, soft warm expression, extreme gold extreme platform lace-up sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
